crossRefs.note: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works…
So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on…
So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…

translations.web: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you had, and none after you will have.”
translations.bsb: therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike anything given to the kings before you or after you.”
translations.kjv: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
translations.asv: wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee; neither shall there any after thee have the like.
